updateMessage:
v1.1.0 adds: 
  - collapsible Workspace panel, 
  - Single Editor/Preview scroll with contents line tracking, 
  - WYSIWYG editing tools for 
      * images, 
      * admonitions, 
      * tables, 
      * tabs 
  directly in the preview, 
  - one-click Markdown-to-MDX conversion, 
  - notifications when your PR gets a review comment or is merged.
